cases.input: Hi Ava. How are you today?
Explain the water cycle simply and show me a clear interactive visual.
Tell me a tiny story about a child drawing with chalk, but do not show a visual.
Compare a seed and a flower in a simple visual so I can see how they are related.
Show me an interactive solar-system visual where I can tap the planets to explore them.
Show butterfly metamorphosis as ordered interactive steps with Back and Next.
